description: This file contains mixins for visually hiding elements and making them accessible to assistive technologies, including techniques for hiding content visually while keeping it accessible and displaying content only when focused.

methods.name: visually-hidden
methods.description: Mixin that visually hides content but keeps it accessible for assistive technologies.

methods.name: visually-hidden-focusable
methods.description: Mixin that displays content only when focused or when a child element is focused, for accessible focus states.
